These Terms of Reference stipulate the requirements 
for potential contractors wishing to participate in the 
tender for the provision of comprehensive project 
management (PMC—Project Management Contractor) 
services for the design, supply, and construction of the 
“Construction of Mullalak Dam and Hydropower plant 
(HPP) in Bostanlyk District of Tashkent Region” 
(hereinafter the ‘Project’) being implemented in 
accordance with the terms of the contract signed 
between Hydraulic Construction Customer Service 
LLC of Uzbekhydroenergo JSC and the Consortium 
consisting 
of 
Dongfang 
Electric 
International 
Corporation (hereinafter the “EPC Contractor”) based 
on the 1999 edition of the FIDIC Silver Book 
(hereinafter the “EPC Contract”).

consortium (hereinafter referred to as the Participant

more partner companies will be selected to provide the

responsibility and accountability for the management of

completion of the Project.

increase in the EPC Contract Price and/or an extension
